pages.text: Digital item and fluid storage - the ME System. Store your entire base's inventory in a searchable network instead of a wall of chests. Pairs well with Tom's Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks if you'd rather not commit to a full ME network right away.

AE2 ships its own in-game guide (the $(bold)GuideMe$() book, found in your inventory or craftable) covering the full ME network from cables to crafting CPUs in far more depth than we will here - open it once you're ready to go past a basic terminal.
